race.comment: BRISEIS ECLIPSE (11) has improved in each of her 2 runs back from a spell and would not mind a firmer surface for her peak run. The Theodore/Callow combination is kicking home winners, and this mare can add to that tally with a win in this. DAMELLI (7) did nothing fresh up in a tougher field at Morphettville 11 days ago, but she can be a quick improver in this company. Stick with her at good odds. ZENACITY (9) had a throat issue after a poor run on a heavy track here 4 weeks ago, where she may have swallowed some dirt in the running. She trialled up fine recently, and with Rochelle Milnes in the saddle, she can make amends. Each way. PRETTY PERKY (5) broke through for an overdue maiden win last season, and she can be expected to improve with racing this prep. Watch for her late and take note of any positive market moves. ALOHA BLUE (3) broke a win drought of over a year when scoring by more than a length at Strathalbyn 10 days ago. This is no harder, so stick with her.
